burn_time_definition: burn_time_s = thrust-on time of the file: sum of the 10 ms record steps with delivered thrust F > 1 N (all burns; +/-0.01 s per burn edge). engine_on_counter_s = sim6 result burn_time (flight-software burn state on): it excludes the shutdown tail-off and, on a propellant-limited run, includes zero-thrust time after liquid depletion until the cut. Index revision 2026-10-13b; earlier v1 / v2 / v3 indexes gave the counter as burn_time_s (Combustion query relayed by the lead 2026-10-13)
max_axial_definition: max_axial_specific_mps2 = maximum of the a_axial_specific_mps2 column over the whole record, leg contact included (pad and touchdown, leg spring-damper contact model of sim6): for a landing at ~1 m/s it is the touchdown load case, for a FAILED landing it is the crash impact, not a design load. max_axial_specific_airborne_mps2 = maximum over the records without leg contact (sim6 leg force = 0: powered ascent, coast, descent, landing burn before contact); max_axial_specific_leg_contact_mps2 = maximum with leg contact. max_axial_at_s / max_axial_phase / max_axial_thrust_N / max_axial_leg_force_N locate the overall maximum. Index revision 2026-10-13c (fields added, no value changed)
